runtime_manifest.nonce_state: six null values; final nonce generation is not authorized by the freeze step and is gated on separate execution GO/NO-GO

freeze_procedure.rationale: The freeze is recorded in a NEW file at the package root (FREEZE-RECORD-v0.4.1.json) that is NOT listed in the freeze-manifest. This keeps the 33 listed files byte-identical to HEAD 64f9a80, preserving their frozen hashes. No substantive design, runner, charter, task, rubric, or evidence-spec change is made; no manifest entry is added, removed, or modified.
